args.title: Fix header handling with quoted column names
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

The `parseStatement` function currently does not correctly handle the header line when column names are double-quoted. The split operation on the header should take quotes into account similarly to how transaction lines are handled.

label: bug

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The issue is a bug in handling quoted column names in the first line of CSV files. The `parseStatement` function in `src/ingest/parser.ts` does not correctly handle headers with quoted column names, causing the column count mismatch.
